title: Create delivery record when delivery option is selected during rent request
gherkin:
Feature: Delivery Lifecycle Management
  Scenario: Create delivery record on delivery selection
    Given an authenticated user has created a rent request for an available rentable item
    When the user selects a delivery option
    Then a delivery record shall be created and associated with the rent record
    And the delivery record shall be initialized with status "Scheduled"
rationale: Validates that the system creates and associates a delivery record when a user selects delivery during rent request creation. This is foundational to the delivery lifecycle management rule.

Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
- All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 min) rule for now.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)

Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
